title: Reserve Bank of India (Payment Banks - Know Your Customer) Amendment Directions, 2026
summary: RBI/2026-27/316 DoR.AML.REC.No.266/14-01-001/2026-27 November 27, 2026 Reserve Bank of India (Payment Banks - Know Your Customer) Amendment Directions, 2026 The Reserve Bank has issued instructions on ‘Operation of Bank Accounts and Money Mules’ in its Reserve Bank of India (Payment Banks – Know Your Customer) Directions, 2025 , where under banks have been directed to undertake diligence measures, monitor the transactions meticulously to identify the accounts, which are operated as Money Mules and take appropriate action. The extant instructions have since been reviewed, and it has been decided to amend the Directions and direct banks by way of a Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) to identify, while protecting genuine customers from inconvenience, highly suspicious transaction / account, including those linked to money mule activity, cyber enabled and other financial frauds, or relating to transactions involving terrorist financing on one’s own behalf or on behalf of another person. It also puts in place a uniform, time-bound procedure for actions to be taken with respect to such transaction / account, including placing debit hold. 2.
